en: Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude is given a claude.ai chat or project link, an artifact from a chat, or an artifact id on its own, it asks for the right link or the content instead of stopping
zh: 改进 Artifact 工具：当 Claude 收到 claude.ai 聊天或项目链接、来自聊天的 artifact 或单独的 artifact id 时，会请求正确的链接或内容，而不是停止
